prompt: I'm making a Roblox game with Rojo in this folder. Concept: "Blade Swarm" - each player has blades orbiting around them, zombies swarm in waves, blades kill zombies, kills give coins, and between waves you buy random upgrades. Today just the first piece: make each player's blades orbit around them and look cool. Decisions: start with 2 blades, orbit radius 7 studs, neon cyan blades. Keep all tunable numbers in one Config module in src/shared, and put every RemoteEvent in a single Remotes module.
result_text:
Each player now gets 2 neon-cyan blades orbiting at 7 studs. I haven't built or run any of it: my `rojo build` check was blocked, so the Luau is untested.

- **`src/shared/Config.lua`**: holds every tunable number: 2 starting blades, radius 7, orbit speed, spin speed, bob, blade size, cyan colour, glow and trail settings.
- **`src/shared/Remotes.lua`**: the one place RemoteEvents are declared. You add a name to its `EVENT_NAMES` list and it creates the events on the server and fetches them on the client. The list is empty because this first piece doesn't need any remotes.
- **`src/server/Blades.server.lua`**: creates the blade parts for each player under `Workspace.Blades/<UserId>/`. It's written so you can change the blade count later (for upgrades). It cleans up when a player leaves.
- **`src/client/BladeOrbit.client.lua`**: moves every player's blades each frame, so the motion is smooth for everyone. Position comes from the synced server clock, so all clients agree on where the blades are.

For the look, each blade is a neon part with a cyan point light and a cyan-to-blue trail. It rolls along its length as it orbits, and it bobs up and down slightly.

I also deleted the three `.gitkeep` files, since those folders now have real files in them. Nothing is committed.

To try it, run `rojo build -o game.rbxlx`, or `rojo serve` and connect from Studio.

The server never moves the blades, so a kill check on the server will have to work out blade positions with the same formula the client uses. I'd put that formula in shared code when we reach kills.
